adjudication.rationale: The diff verifiably removes “add members at creation” support: `admin/templates/group.hbs` now wraps the members UI (including the `user-selector` and add button) in `{{#if id}}`, so it only appears after the group has an id. Correspondingly, the model/controller APIs `createWithUsernames` / `saveWithUsernames` were removed and `Group.create()` / `Group.save()` no longer send usernames in `asJSON()`. Members can only be added later via the new `addMembers` action hitting `PUT /admin/groups/:id/members.json`. This is a feature/UX regression/change, but not an internal correctness bug (creation still works, and members can still be added after creation).
